requirements_summary: SMB SaaS helpdesk: live chat + async support assistant. Primary workload = short chat responses (avg 40-120 tokens) and on-demand FAQ embeddings. Traffic pattern: low steady-state (10-30 RPS) with frequent short spikes up to ~180-220 RPS during marketing pushes and product launches. Latency target: 150-600ms tail for quick UI responses; cost-sensitive, wants to keep monthly API spend under $10k if possible. Preference = hosted API (self-serve). Needs predictable 429 semantics, optional burst credits, guidance on concurrency limits and client backoff. SSO required for admin console + audit log export. No private deployment at this stage.
